nodes.description: mapping(uint256 => uint256) private tokenMatrix used to swap-and-pop pseudo-random token indices in nextToken().
bool public saleIsActive; toggled by flipSaleState and required to be true in mint().
uint public pixxoPrice = 0.004 ether; price per NFT used in the mint() payment check.
uint public constant MAX_MINTS_PER_TX = 10; upper bound of tokens mintable in one transaction.
uint public constant MAX_MINT = 4444; total collection cap returned by maxSupply().
uint public totalReserveMint; tracks reserved mints performed by claimReserve().
uint public constant MAX_RESERVE_MINT = 5; number of reserved tokens and offset added to every minted id.
string public ipfsBase; base URI returned by _baseURI() and mutable via setBaseURI().
uint256[] private _ones = [1,1,1,1,1]; equal share list passed to PaymentSplitter for 5 payees.
constructor(address[] payees) sets ERC721 name/symbol, initializes PaymentSplitter shares and enforces exactly 5 payees.
claimReserve() onlyOwner: mints MAX_RESERVE_MINT tokens to msg.sender, guarded by totalReserveMint < MAX_RESERVE_MINT.
_baseURI() internal view override returning ipfsBase.
setBaseURI(string uri) onlyOwner: overwrites ipfsBase metadata base.
flipSaleState() onlyOwner: inverts saleIsActive.
setPrice(uint256 _price) onlyOwner: sets pixxoPrice.
mint(uint n) public payable: validates amount, sale state, supply and payment, then loops calling _mintPixxo(msg.sender).
_mintPixxo(address to) internal: obtains nextToken() index and calls _safeMint(to, mintIndex).
tokenURI(uint256 _tokenId) view override: returns baseURI + tokenId + '.json' after an existence check.
maxSupply() public pure returning MAX_MINT.
nextToken() internal: derives pseudo-random index from block variables, manipulates tokenMatrix and returns offset + MAX_RESERVE_MINT.
release(address payable account) public virtual inherited from PaymentSplitter: computes pending payment and forwards Ether via Address.sendValue.
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller, used as mint recipient and as randomness entropy.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value mixed into the nextToken() randomness seed.
_mint(msg.sender, MAX_RESERVE_MINT) in claimReserve(): privileged mint of reserved tokens to the owner.
require((n * pixxoPrice) <= msg.value) in mint(): unpaid-ether arithmetic check, multiplication cannot overflow n <= 10 but deliberately allows overpayment.
_safeMint(to, mintIndex): mints an NFT and invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, creating an external callback window.
uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp))) % maxIndex: weak on-chain randomness, miner-influenceable.
require(totalSupply() + n <= maxSupply()) in mint(): supply arithmetic guarding the mint cap.
maxSupply() - totalSupply() in nextToken(): remaining supply arithmetic used as the random modulo bound.
Address.sendValue(account, payment): raw recipient.call{value: amount}('') transferring Ether before/without reentrancy guard.
address[] memory payees: constructor parameter, must have length 5 and match _ones.
uint256 i: constructor loop counter over payees.
uint n: caller supplied mint quantity in mint().
uint i: mint() loop counter driving repeated _mintPixxo calls.
address to: recipient parameter of _mintPixxo(), receives the freshly minted token.
uint mintIndex: token id returned by nextToken() and passed to _safeMint.
uint256 _tokenId: token id argument of tokenURI().
uint256 maxIndex: remaining supply bound inside nextToken() used for modulo and swap-and-pop.
uint256 random: pseudo-random index derived from block entropy, modulo maxIndex.
uint256 offset: returned token offset selected from tokenMatrix or random in nextToken().
string memory uri: new metadata base supplied to setBaseURI().
uint256 _price: new mint price supplied to setPrice().
address payable account: payee whose pending Ether share is released in release().
uint256 totalReceived: contract balance plus already released Ether inside release().
uint256 payment: pending Ether amount computed for account and passed to Address.sendValue.

edges.reason: payees array is consumed by the constructor which validates length and registers each payee.
constructor loop counter drives iteration over payees/shares during initialization.
caller-supplied n is multiplied by pixxoPrice inside the msg.value payment requirement.
pixxoPrice state variable is the multiplier of n in the payment check.
mint() executes the require((n * pixxoPrice) <= msg.value) payment gate.
untrusted n is added to totalSupply() in the max supply bound check.
mint() executes require(totalSupply() + n <= maxSupply()).
mint() loop calls _mintPixxo(msg.sender) n times.
mint() loop counter governs how many times _mintPixxo is invoked.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'to' recipient of _mintPixxo().
_mintPixxo binds its recipient parameter 'to' for the minting flow.
recipient 'to' becomes the target address of the _safeMint call.
mintIndex produced by nextToken() is passed as the token id to _safeMint.
_mintPixxo calls nextToken() to obtain the next mintable index.
nextToken() return value is stored in mintIndex.
maxIndex local is computed as maxSupply() - totalSupply() inside nextToken().
nextToken() invokes maxSupply() to determine the remaining supply bound.
MAX_MINT constant is returned by maxSupply().
nextToken() subtracts totalSupply() from maxSupply(), the core supply arithmetic.
block.timestamp is packed into the randomness seed, making the draw miner-influenceable.
msg.sender is part of the abi.encodePacked entropy for the pseudo-random index.
nextToken() execution builds and applies the block-variable randomness computation.
maxIndex is the modulo bound applied to the keccak256 randomness.
the modulo randomness result is assigned to the local 'random'.
nextToken() reads and writes tokenMatrix to swap-and-pop used indices.
the selected token offset is stored in the local 'offset' before being returned.
MAX_RESERVE_MINT is the mint amount in the reserve _mint call.
totalReserveMint is read to guard claimReserve against repeated reserve claims.
claimReserve writes totalReserveMint = MAX_RESERVE_MINT after minting.
MAX_RESERVE_MINT bounds and sizes the reserve mint in claimReserve.
msg.sender must be the owner (onlyOwner) and becomes the reserve mint recipient.
claimReserve executes the privileged _mint(msg.sender, MAX_RESERVE_MINT) call.
msg.sender is the recipient argument of the reserve _mint.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the recipient, allowing a malicious msg.sender contract to reenter during minting.
_baseURI returns the ipfsBase state variable.
setBaseURI takes the new uri parameter.
owner-supplied uri overwrites ipfsBase.
flipSaleState, restricted to the owner, toggles the saleIsActive flag.
setPrice receives the new price parameter.
owner-supplied _price writes the pixxoPrice state variable.
tokenURI takes the token id parameter for the metadata lookup.
tokenURI calls _baseURI() to build the metadata string.
mint() requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mint() reads pixxoPrice to price the requested quantity.
release computes totalReceived from the contract balance plus totalReleased().
release computes the pending payment amount via _pendingPayment.
release forwards Ether through Address.sendValue after state updates, exposing a low-level call.
the arbitrary payee account is the target of the low-level call in sendValue.
release consumes the payee account argument for share lookup and payout.

normalization_plan.reason: The payees array is a constructor-only input used solely to seed PaymentSplitter shares; fold it into the constructor node.
The constructor loop index has no independent semantic weight; collapse it into the constructor.
The mint quantity parameter only exists to drive mint() validation and looping; merge it into mint().
The mint() loop counter is an implementation detail of the mint loop; absorb it into mint().
The recipient parameter belongs to _mintPixxo's minting logic; merge it into that function.
mintIndex is the transient token id used by _mintPixxo and should be folded into it.
The token id parameter is only meaningful inside tokenURI(); merge it there.
maxIndex is a nextToken() internal bookkeeping value; collapse it into nextToken().
The random index directly carries the weak block-entropy draw, so it normalizes into the randomness unsafe operation.
offset is the locally computed return index of nextToken(); fold it into nextToken().
The uri parameter is the sole input of setBaseURI(); merge it into that function.
The _price parameter is the sole input of setPrice(); merge it into that function.
The payable account parameter drives the release() payout; normalize it into release().
totalReceived is a release()-local aggregation; absorb it into release().
The payment local is the value passed to Address.sendValue, so it merges into the low-level transfer operation.
